# MLPerf Inference harness (doc/15-benchmarks.md#the-harness).
# LoadGen is built here by our CMake from the fetched sources: its own CMakeLists writes
# generated files into its source tree, which stays untouched. C++ is confined to this
# directory (doc/19-decisions-and-risks.md, D-22).
enable_language(CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)

set(LG_DIR "${PR3_THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/mlperf-inference/loadgen")
set(LG_GEN "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/loadgen_gen")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${LG_GEN}")

# mlperf_conf.h: the benchmark rules embedded as a C string, as LoadGen expects.
file(READ "${LG_DIR}/mlperf.conf" lg_conf)
string(REPLACE "\\" "\\\\" lg_conf "${lg_conf}")
string(REPLACE "\"" "\\\"" lg_conf "${lg_conf}")
string(REPLACE "\n" "\\n\"\n\"" lg_conf "${lg_conf}")
file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT "${LG_GEN}/mlperf_conf.h"
  CONTENT "// Generated by bench/mlperf/CMakeLists.txt from LoadGen's mlperf.conf; do not edit.\nconst char* mlperf_conf =\n\"@lg_conf@\";\n"
  @ONLY)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${LG_DIR}/mlperf.conf")

# version_generated.cc: LoadGen's version, git revision and file hashes, which every run logs.
file(GLOB lg_hashed_files CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${LG_DIR}/*" "${LG_DIR}/bindings/*")
add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT "${LG_GEN}/version_generated.cc"
  COMMAND Python3::Interpreter -I -W ignore::DeprecationWarning "${LG_DIR}/version_generator.py" "${LG_GEN}/version_generated.cc" "${LG_DIR}"
  DEPENDS "${LG_DIR}/version_generator.py" "${LG_DIR}/VERSION.txt" ${lg_hashed_files}
  COMMENT "Generating LoadGen version information"
  VERBATIM)

add_library(mlperf_loadgen STATIC
  "${LG_DIR}/early_stopping.cc"
  "${LG_DIR}/issue_query_controller.cc"
  "${LG_DIR}/loadgen.cc"
  "${LG_DIR}/logging.cc"
  "${LG_DIR}/results.cc"
  "${LG_DIR}/test_settings_internal.cc"
  "${LG_DIR}/utils.cc"
  "${LG_DIR}/version.cc"
  "${LG_GEN}/version_generated.cc")
target_include_directories(mlperf_loadgen PUBLIC "${LG_DIR}" PRIVATE "${LG_GEN}")
target_link_libraries(mlperf_loadgen PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
# LoadGen times every query; keep it optimized in every preset, as its own build does.
if(NOT MSVC)
  target_compile_options(mlperf_loadgen PRIVATE -O3)
endif()

# The C ABI over LoadGen.
add_library(pr3_loadgen STATIC pr3_loadgen.cc)
target_include_directories(pr3_loadgen PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(pr3_loadgen PRIVATE mlperf_loadgen)
pr3_target_warnings(pr3_loadgen)

# The pr3_mlperf command and its systems under test.
add_executable(pr3_mlperf pr3_mlperf.c sut_loopback.c)
target_link_libraries(pr3_mlperf PRIVATE pr3_loadgen Threads::Threads)
target_compile_definitions(pr3_mlperf PRIVATE PR3_VERSION_STRING="${PROJECT_VERSION}")
set_target_properties(pr3_mlperf PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX)
pr3_target_warnings(pr3_mlperf)

# Smoke runs: a few seconds each, and they must reach a VALID result.
foreach(scenario SingleStream Offline)
  add_test(NAME mlperf_smoke_${scenario}
    COMMAND pr3_mlperf --sut loopback --scenario ${scenario} --performance 256
            --user-conf "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/conf/smoke.conf"
            --out "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/runs/smoke-${scenario}" --quiet)
  set_tests_properties(mlperf_smoke_${scenario} PROPERTIES
    TIMEOUT 120
    LABELS "bench;mlperf"
    ENVIRONMENT "TSAN_OPTIONS=suppressions=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tsan.supp halt_on_error=1")
endforeach()
